hdr.name: Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica Punta Cacique

flags: Venue abroad (Costa Rica): the venue quotes in US dollars. Our Bay Area price sheet does not apply abroad: lines the venue has not priced show unknown (ask the venue or a local supplier).

notes.t: From the venue's documents: Waldorf Package, 60 guests (++ taxes and service): $30,800
From the venue's documents: Astoria Package, 60 guests (++ taxes and service): $38,900
Rooms average about $1,000++ per room per night
Venue said $20,000 would only work for up to 30 guests
Website check: hilton.com pages return 403 to automated reads; the address comes from Hilton's page as shown in search results (not read directly); capacity from Hilton's own press release.

Website check: Hilton's events page (search snippet) says venues 'gather up to 300 guests'; the press release says up to 382 attendees across ballrooms and lawn; each ceremonial pavilion holds 'up to 100 guests'.
Website check: No reliable map point: Nominatim has only the Punta Cacique headland (10.5701653, -85.6955735), not the hotel; lat/lon left null.
Website check: Email facts ($400++ per guest F&B, ~$1,000++ rooms) are not on the public pages; kept.
Waldorf Package for 60 guests: $30,800++ ($513++ per guest)
Astoria Package for 60 guests: $38,900++ ($648++ per guest)

Waldorf Package: beach ceremony, reception at Hermosa Pavilion, plated dinner in Cacique Ballroom, sound system, arch, bouquet; Gold dinner = 4 hors d'oeuvres, four-course dinner, sparkling toast, 4-hour hosted bar
Astoria Package adds 2-hour photography; Platinum dinner = seven-course dinner and 5-hour hosted bar
Package prices exclude lodging, entertainment, taxes and service charges
Resort has six dining outlets; hotel phone +506 4104-0700
